description: Bar count, total length, stock bars and mass for a slab or pad mat or a strip footing, using CSA G30.18 metric bar sizes. Every parameter is optional and has a default. Preliminary planning only. Take the bar list, cover, laps and hooks from the drawings; the engineer of record governs.

lap.description: Lap splice length from the drawings. 0 adds no laps. Unit: mm.

layout.description: Slab or pad mat (mat) or strip footing (strip).

length.description: Slab length or footing length. Unit: m or ft.

long_bars.description: Number of longitudinal bars in the footing.

spacing.description: Bar spacing each way (mat) or transverse bar spacing (strip). Unit: mm.

width.description: Slab width or footing width. Unit: m or ft.

name: rebar_quantity_calculator
title: Rebar Quantity Calculator
